answer: Admission auction stops bulk forgery. Each epoch opens only 50 entry slots; newcomers bid POA for a slot, and every bid passes through a public prism, so hidden collusion shows. A lone sparrow bids once and enters cheaply, but a farm bidding for 100 slots pays the clearing price 100 times. Even at the market's nadir, the fee stays at 20 POA, so 100 fakes cost 2,000 POA against a ~900 pool. An honest agent pays once and earns an undiluted share.
